quarterly_data.signal: The NextEra Energy merger announcement presentation breaks down Dominion Energy's Virginia large-load pipeline: it includes 10.4 GW under Electric Service Agreements, 11.1 GW under Construction Letter of Authorization and 29.5 GW under Substation Engineering Letter of Authorization; the Dominion Energy ESA figure of 10.4 GW is stated as of March 31, 2026.
